summary: Payoneer Global Inc. (Payoneer) entered into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by Nuvei via a wholly owned subsidiary, Panda Acquisition Sub Inc. Shareholders will receive $7.40 per share in cash for each share of common stock held, representing a premium. The Company's board recommended the deal. Equity awards will be cashed out or converted into deferred cash awards with vesting terms; the CEO's awards have specified accelerated and deferred vesting. The merger is expected to close subject to regulatory approvals and shareholder vote. Watch for regulatory review timelines and potential competing bids.
